preconditions.description: K must be between 1 and the length of the string S.
The length of the string S must not exceed 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min(S[i:] + S[:i] for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by rotating the string S.
